text: D207101 discussed names for the keep-or-discard callback. A reviewer suggested getShouldKeepMessage; the author preferred onRetentionQuery because the callback is a query during store compaction, and that name landed. Keep the exact onRetentionQuery API name when extending this listener. This decision is scoped to this API; it does not establish a general rule against get-prefixed methods.
title: The accepted store callback name is onRetentionQuery
